headline: Approved a Procopio off-site road agreement, a firefighters' union contract, and a hearing on a water assessment district.
summary: Department heads presented their proposed fiscal 2028 budgets, including a legal services line of $420,000, up from $200,000 this year. Residents asked the council to keep spending to the default budget. Other speakers raised fire chief pay and impact fees.
decisions: Accepted the resignation of Ms. Allen from the Senior Resource Committee, 5-0.
Approved the tentative contract with the firefighters' union, IAFF Local 3160, for July 1st, 2027 through June 30th, 2030, subject to voter approval of cost items, unanimously.
Scheduled a public hearing for November 30th, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. on the proposed water special assessment district, 5-0.
Approved the off-site improvements agreement with Procopio and authorized the acting town manager to sign it, 4-1.
discussion: Legal services budget: Members questioned the proposed $420,000 legal services line, up from $200,000 this year. Staff said the figure is based on hourly rates of $275 to $505 and on expected union contracts.

Assistant town manager position: Members debated whether to fund an assistant town manager position or a stipend for succession planning. Some questioned why past assistant positions were not used when the town manager job was vacant.
Procopio agreement: Members questioned allowing 25 certificates of occupancy before the left turn lane is finished, and asked what protections exist if the developer cannot finish the work.
Fire chief pay: A resident questioned a pay raise and a $5,075.20 lump-sum payment to the fire chief, and asked why pay bands are used if they are not followed.
Impact fees: A resident asked the council to take up impact fees, which the town stopped collecting in February of 2013, and said the town has lost hundreds of thousands of dollars.
